instruction:
Use Abaqus/CAE through the graphical user interface to build a contact analysis assembly from scratch. Use the N-mm-MPa unit system.

Model Definition:
Create two 3D Deformable Solid parts using Extrusion. For Part-1 (Block), sketch a rectangle from (0, 0) to (20, 20) in the X-Y plane and extrude along the global Z-axis to 30 mm. For Part-2 (Plate), sketch a rectangle from (0, 0) to (100, 100) in the X-Y plane and extrude along the global Z-axis to 5 mm.

Material and Section:
Define a material named Steel with Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa and Poisson's ratio nu = 0.3. Create a single Solid Homogeneous section using Steel and assign it to both the block and the plate.

Assembly:
Instantiate both parts in the assembly. Apply a Coincident Point constraint to align the center of the block bottom face (10, 10, 0) with the center of the plate top face (50, 50, 5). Verify that the block sits directly on top of the plate with no gap and no initial penetration.

Analysis Step:
Create a Static, General step named Step-1 with nonlinear geometry enabled (Nlgeom = ON).

Contact Interaction:
Establish a General Contact (Standard) or Surface-to-Surface Contact (Standard) interaction. Assign the plate top face (outer surface at Z = 5) as the master surface and the block bottom face (outer surface at Z = 0 of the block instance) as the slave surface. Configure the contact property as Frictionless with Hard Contact.

Loads and Boundary Conditions:
Apply an Encastre boundary condition to the bottom face of the plate (Z = 0). Apply a pressure of 10 MPa to the top face of the block (Z = 30 mm), acting downward toward the block interior (global -Z direction).

Discretization:
Mesh the block with element type C3D8R using a global seed size of 3 mm. Mesh the plate with element type C3D8R using a global seed size of 5 mm.

Job Execution:
Create a job named Job-Contact, submit it for analysis, and wait for the analysis to complete successfully.

Post-Processing:
Review the contact pressure CPRESS contour and the Mises stress contour in the output database.

Deliverables:
Save the model database as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-Contact.cae and ensure the output database is written to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-Contact.odb.
